possibilities.title: Air-gapped contractor teams can roll local code agents across mixed laptop fleets

with.title: Cline Desktop installs local models matched to your hardware

possibilities.connection: On 2026-10-22 Magpie suggested defense contractors run code agents on air-gapped laptops with Graphify context, and today Cline Desktop adds hardware checks that recommend local models that fit each machine, while Graphify keeps gaining users.

possibilities.title: Due diligence code audits can run live with the target's engineers present

with.title: Rapid-MLX 0.16.9 cuts repeat long-prompt start to 0.39 s

possibilities.connection: On 2026-10-23 Magpie suggested due diligence consultants could security-audit an acquisition target's code on one laptop with Flint on Rapid-MLX, a Graphify code map and an audit skill; today's Rapid-MLX 0.16.9 reuses prompt state so a repeated ~32K-token prompt starts in 0.39 s instead of 18.6 s, turning each follow-up question from a wait into a conversation.

possibilities.title: Legacy codebases become cheap to query with auditable context
possibilities.connection: A cheap 1M-token model paired with a deterministic, explainable codebase graph gives long-context answers you can trace to source.

Cloudflare open-sources a security-audit skill for coding agents

possibilities.connection: Flint runs fast on a Mac via Rapid-MLX, Graphify gives it an auditable map of the codebase, and Cloudflare's audit skill turns that into verified, machine-readable findings, all without code leaving the machine.

with.title: Recursive releases Flint, an open 40B MoE coding model
OpenCode open-source coding agent ships v2.1.2

possibilities.connection: Flint provides a laptop-class open coding model, Graphify gives it local repo context with explained edges, and OpenCode supplies the open agent loop, so the whole stack runs with no network calls.

possibilities.title: Open source maintainers can triage agent-found vulnerabilities locally before disclosure deadlines

with.title: OpenAI launches Patch the Planet vulnerability coordination effort
Shanghai AI Lab opens Sage-A1.5 agentic MoE model

possibilities.connection: Patch the Planet signals a coming flood of agent-found bugs, Graphify maps the blast radius of each one with explained edges, and Sage-A1.5 runs the triage agent cheaply on modest hardware without sharing undisclosed bugs.

possibilities.title: Insurers can run legacy code war rooms on local models instead of token budgets

with.title: Ornith-1.5-122B open coding model free and local via Ollama
GEICO talk on an AI war room for legacy code

possibilities.connection: GEICO's talk frames $1,000 a day in tokens for legacy code work, and an MIT-licensed local coding model plus a deterministic code knowledge graph could do much of that work in-house.

appearances.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
appearances.summary: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

appearances.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
appearances.headline: Graphify turns codebases into queryable knowledge graphs
appearances.newly_possible: Coding agents can query a codebase, plus its docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs, as a local knowledge graph built from AST parsing with no vector store.
appearances.why: Deterministic, explained edges give agents codebase context you can audit, without running embedding infrastructure.
appearances.limits: No evidence yet that it improves agent task success.
